summary.text: Cameron Parker is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 150 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Parker, who appears on Ballotpedia as Cameron Bunting Parker, is an attorney who chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cameron Bunting Parker lives in Campbell, Missouri, and graduated from Risco High School.
She earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Missouri-Columbia in 1995 and a J.D. from the Mississippi College School of Law in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney in private practice, and she served on the Campbell school board and the Women's Domestic Violence Shelter board.
Parker took office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Andrew McDaniel.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Judiciary Committee and the Joint Committee on the Justice System, and as vice chair of the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee.
